description: Uncanny Cat Golf is a game about shooting a cat into various golf holes, with hijinx aplenty

1.0.1.description:
- [APWorld] Fixed 2-8 not requiring Breakable Tiles
- [APWorld] Fixed P-7 not requiring Keys
- [Mod] Fixed the mod not properly sending Smiley checks on some levels
1.0.1.title: Uncanny Cat Golf Archipelago v1.0.1

1.0.2.description:
- [APWorld] Fixed E-7 not logically requiring Breakable Tiles
- [APWorld] Changed 2-4 to not logically require Go Markers for Good/Peak ranks
- [APWorld] Changed 2-15 to not logically require Go Markers for Good/Peak ranks
- [Mod] Improved gift popup handling immensely to prevent overlapping present icons
- [Mod] Fixed UNCANNY_DASH not sending any checks.
- [Mod] Fixed Meowls sending all of its checks when opening it
- [Mod] Added a multitude of extra ap connection checks, to ensure that you can safely play with the AP mod enabled, without connecting to AP.
- [Mod] Fixed issues with stop/go markers when being unlocked
1.0.2.title: Uncanny Cat Golf Archipelago v1.0.2

1.0.3.description:
- [APWorld] Changed 2-4 Peak Rank to logically require Go Markers
- [APWorld] Changed 2-13 Peak/Good Rank to not logically require Go Markers
- [APWorld] Changed 3-17 Peak/Good Rank to not logically require Go Markers
- [APWorld] Changed the default for minigames to be off, instead of on, because not everyone wants to play this game for the minigames
- [Mod] Fixed goal levels being accessible early by playing the level before them
- [Mod] Fixed E-9 crashing the game upon completion
1.0.3.title: Uncanny Cat Golf Archipelago v1.0.3
